description: Rules entry for the seeded legal-character generator and its relationship to standard character creation.

entries.title: Random Operative Generator
entries.summary: A seeded generator that creates complete Rating 1 operatives under the same standard package used by guided creation and transfers them directly into the Basic Character Sheet.
body: The generator is an alternative interface for standard character creation, not a separate creation method. Every generated operative begins with all nine Attributes at 1 and distributes exactly nine additional Attribute Points, for eighteen total dots with no Attribute above 4.

Every generated operative receives exactly twenty-four Skill Points. One role-appropriate Signature Skill is set to 4, every other Skill remains at 3 or lower, and two specializations are selected only from Skills rated 2 or higher.

The generator chooses one Operational Frame, one Archetype at Rating 1, all required integrated variant records, the Archetype's automatic Starting Ability, and two additional eligible Rank 1 abilities purchased with the two Starting Ability Points.

Equipment is selected from the established modern, historical, future, scavenged, survival, relic, and alien-template catalogs. The No Return Signal opening override remains in effect: generated equipment represents training and preferred requisition unless the opening scene explicitly provides it.

A seed recreates the same complete operative when the same controls are used. Identity, statistics, purchased abilities, equipment, and relationships can also be rerolled independently without changing the other generated sections.

Transfer to Character Sheet writes the existing blacklight-continuum-basic-character schema to the same local record used by manual and guided creation. The resulting sheet remains editable, printable, and exportable.

tables.title: Generated Standard Package
rows: 24 total points; one Signature Skill at 4; all others 0–3
Two, each attached to a Skill rated 2 or higher
One of twelve role profiles with weighted Attributes, Skills, function, and equipment
One of six at Rating 1 with Resource, Pressure, weakness, and innate abilities
Required lineage, variant, Source, Conviction, Paradigm, Order, or other records
One automatic ability plus two purchased Rank 1 abilities
Primary weapon or tool, protection, field kit, two supplies, and personal object
All eight required character-creation prompts plus affiliation, safe site, and complication
Printable preview, exportable JSON, or direct Basic Character Sheet transfer
